blocks.text: “This award proves the idea HypeOn AI is built on: give AI the right signals, and a lean team can grow like a large one,” says Yash Kumar. “That is exactly what we now bring to every brand we work with.”
Google published these figures with the award ([source](https://business.google.com/uk/accelerate/ads-impact-awards/wallpassion/)):

rows: Return on ad spend in Finland
Local team needed in new territories

blocks.text: Wallpassion had grown about as far as it could in Sweden. The home market was saturated, and each extra krona of ad spend bought less.

The next step was going abroad, starting with Finland. The usual route is costly: hire a country team, open an office and hope demand shows up. Yash needed a way in that was low-risk and profitable from the start.
Approach: one AI engine instead of many country teams
Instead of building teams and offices in each market, Yash built one centralised growth engine on Google's Performance Max. Three choices made it work:

items: **Localised creative.** Google's AI got assets made for each market, so ads felt native to Finnish shoppers, not translated from Swedish.
**Value-based signals.** Smart Bidding with target ROAS and value-based bidding meant the system chased revenue and profit, not cheap clicks.
**Test before committing.** ROAS targets were raised step by step, so real local demand was proven before spend scaled.

blocks.text: The result was profitable from the first market, and new-market acquisition costs cut by 45%.
What this means for HypeOn AI customers
The same principles behind the award now power how HypeOn AI helps e-commerce and DTC brands grow:

items: **Better inputs beat bigger budgets.** Most brands underperform because their feeds, creative and conversion values are thin, not because the ad platforms are weak.
**Growth without extra headcount.** A lean team with the right AI systems can enter markets that once needed whole departments.
**Profit first.** Optimising for real value, not vanity metrics, is what made this expansion pay back from day one.

blocks.text: Yash Kumar is the Founder & CEO of HypeOn AI and founder of Adroot, a performance marketing agency for DTC brands. He also leads digital and growth across 12 European markets as Head of Digital at Wallpassion.

His career spans advertising at Amazon, performance marketing at Tata 1mg and marketing leadership at Altered AI in London. He is a Venture Partner at LvlUp Ventures and a Venture Lab mentor at IE Business School.
